correctness.rationale: Exactly computed Q difference multiplicities and all eleven facets establish f-vector 11,55,110,55,11. The 55 missing triangles form one affine orbit; one explicit three-triangle disk fills its representative, giving pi_1=0. Fifty-five free-face elementary pairs collapse all dimension >=3 faces. Euler characteristic 22, integral H_1=0 and free H_2 yield a wedge of 21 two-spheres by Hurewicz/Whitehead. Signed fixed-face Lefschetz gives character 21,-1,1 on groups of sizes 1,10,44; averaging yields one invariant rational H_2 class. Standalone programs enumerate and check each finite premise.

value.rationale: The Paley-11 tournament is the canonical doubly regular tournament/11-point biplane; the new result exactly determines an integral homotopy type for the directed neighborhood complex at a source-motivated gap. Its full affine rational character and symmetry quotient provide new information beyond nonequivariant Betti numbers, and the elementary incidence/orbit proof is structurally reusable.
